steps: After explicit all-ended signal, freeze eligible paths under exactly the three authorized evidence prefixes.
Exclude private data/baseline/server/session/SQLite and runtime/profile aliases before choosing any compression input; abort if helper eligibility exceeds the safe frozen snapshot.
Run deterministic mtime0/filename-free gzip for ended untracked large text artifacts only; preserve every original, tracked oracle and ZIP.
Save final storage-index snapshot separately while retaining every earlier index and failed/prior receipt.
Freshly verify gzip hash plus decompressed original hash/size and retained original hash/size in a separate process.

Generate staging plan using ABSOLUTE --staging-plan path, then filter it to safe ended snapshot plus new indexed gzip/storage metadata; omit compressed original twins and all newly appeared future outputs.
Confirm no unexpected >Git-file-limit raw artifact appears in exact plan; perform no Git staging/push or external upload.
scope: Packaging verification only; no new application or genuine-wallet acceptance.
